title: Creation: ancestry-granted skill proficiencies are not on the sheet, so level-1 expertise cannot target them
description: Found in eshyra-nnj6.1. Decision 3 said expertise options derive from class + background + ancestry skills, but buildFinalizedCharacter stores only background fixed + chosen class skills in sheet.skillProficiencies (ancestry skills such as Half-Orc Menacing / Elf Keen Senses are not recorded). Expertise eligibility follows the sheet (same as level-up), so ancestry skills are not offered. Decide whether ancestry skill grants belong on the sheet.
design: Ancestry skill grants belong on CharacterSheet.skillProficiencies: SRD Keen Senses (Elf/High Elf) grants Perception, Menacing (Half-Orc) grants Intimidation, Skill Versatility (Half-Elf) grants two chosen skills. Use a narrow source-cited consumer overlay for fixed grants and the existing creation-choice metadata for Half-Elf. Apply grants consistently to duplicate replacements, finalization, and creation expertise eligibility/staleness; exclude conditional Stonecunning/Artificers Lore from unconditional skill grants. No generated pack edits or existing-sheet migration. Branch began from refreshed origin/main and includes pending PR #618 as an implementation dependency; PR targets main and must follow #618.
notes:
Implemented and handed off in PR https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/621 (commit 8142a1f2, branch eshyra-jah7). Ancestry skill proficiencies now belong on the finalized sheet and feed expertise eligibility and duplicate replacements: Elf/High Elf Keen Senses, Half-Orc Menacing, Half-Elf Skill Versatility choices. Expertise becomes stale when the held ancestry skill disappears. Conditional History traits stay excluded. No generated pack edits or saved-sheet migration. Evidence: source-backed resolver checks; creation -> SQLite -> level-up; ancestry/choice changes; triple overlapping ancestry/background/class grants. npm run verify:worktree passed (6149 passed, 3 documented skips), formatting/check/forced typecheck passed; hidden-Unicode check repeated after staging new file. Worktree clean and feature branch pushed. Includes dependency PR #618 commit 78c5a881 and must merge after #618; dependency recorded on eshyra-nnj6. Leave in_progress until PR #621 merges.
